steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Explain the difference between RNA and DNA.

steps.action:
DNA  
• Sugar: deoxyribose (lacks one oxygen)  
• Bases: A, C, G, T  
• Structure: usually double-stranded, long, stable helix  
• Role: long-term storage of genetic information in nucleus (or nucleoid)

RNA  
• Sugar: ribose (has extra oxygen)  
• Bases: A, C, G, U (uracil replaces thymine)  
• Structure: usually single-stranded, shorter, folds into many shapes  
• Role: transient carrier and functional molecule (mRNA, rRNA, tRNA, etc.); works in nucleus & cytoplasm, less chemically stable
